_notice: NEVER USED. Example only: copy to v02-result\queue-config.json (gitignored, at the repository root) after the R04 installer is installed. Values in <angle brackets> are placeholders. productName must equal the DisplayName of the installer's Windows uninstall entry; installedExe must lie under its InstallLocation. expectedEffectRows is how many synthetic sources the operator imports per scenario (one succeeded extraction each). The scenario is chosen on the command line (--scenario).
